NONE: A2 used to say that a particular thing can or will happen only after something else happens or becomes true
› used to mean "if it is true that"
B1 used to introduce a clause, often in indirect speech, that shows two or more possibilities
（用於引出從句，常為間接引語）是否
› used when you want to make a polite request or remark
（用於禮貌地作出請求或評論）
› something that is not certain or not yet decided
不確定因素；未決之事；疑問

example: I'll pay you double if you get the work finished by Friday.
如果你週五前完工，我付你雙倍的報酬。
We'll have the party in the garden if the weather's good. If not (= if the weather is not good), it'll have to be inside.
如果天氣好的話，我們將在花園裡開派對。如果不好，就只好在室內了。
If anyone calls, just say I'll be back in the office at four o'clock.
要是有人給我打電話，請告訴他們我四點鐘回辦公室。
If she hadn't called, I wouldn't have known.
要不是她打電話來，我還不知道呢。
I wouldn't work for them (even) if they paid me twice my current salary.
即使他們付給我的工資是現在的兩倍，我也不會為他們工作。
We'll deal with that problem if and when it arises.
等到那個問題出現我們再處理。
If disturbed, the bird may abandon the nest, leaving the chicks to die.
如果受到驚擾，鳥可能會棄巢而去，留下雛鳥，任由牠們死亡。
They're great kids, even if they can be demanding.
雖然他們要求多多，但他們是很好的孩子。
literary It was a hot, if windy day.
那天雖然有風，卻依然很熱。
If water is heated to 100°C it turns to steam.
水被加熱到攝氏100度時，就會變成蒸汽。
If I don't get enough sleep I get a headache.
我睡眠不足時就會頭痛。
I'm very sorry if I've offended you.
如果我冒犯了你的話，我很抱歉。
Mrs Kramer called half an hour ago to ask if her cake was ready.
克雷默夫人半小時前來電話問她的蛋糕做好了沒有。
I don't care if he likes it or not - I'm coming!
我不在乎他喜不喜歡，我反正要來！
I was wondering if you'd like to come to the cinema with me this evening?
不知你今晚想不想與我一起去看電影？
Compare
whether
If you'd like to take a seat, Mr Chang will be with you in a moment.
請您先坐一會兒吧，張先生一會兒就過來。
Would you mind if I open/opened (= can I open) the window?
我開窗您介意嗎？
There are, if you don't mind me saying so, one or two problems with this plan.
恕我冒昧，我覺得這個計劃有一兩個問題。
There's a big if hanging over the project (= it is uncertain whether the project will happen).
這個計劃能否付諸實行仍然懸而未決。
